subject: general
question: Where is the ozone hole located?

options.text: Over the North and South Poles

solution:
The correct answer is "__**Over Antarctica**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **protective ozone layer** in the stratosphere is thinned, causing the ozone hole.
 
• **Ozone holes** detected in the late 1990s and early 2000s are significantly larger than the 2021 **Antarctic** ozone hole, while being larger than average.
 
• In certain cases, the ozone hole over Antarctica has gotten so big that it is affecting **Australia, New Zealand, Chile, Argentina, and parts of South Africa**.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is "**Over Antarctica**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ozone "hole," formerly thought to pose the greatest threat to planetary life, is now anticipated to be fully repaired by **2066**.
